tools.name: project_overview
tools.summary: Orient in the codebase: stats, biggest files, most depended-upon symbols.

tools.name: context
tools.summary: Everything about one symbol in a budgeted bundle: code, callers, tests, deps, docs.

tools.name: find_symbols
tools.summary: Symbol lookup by name or wildcard — returns node ids for the other tools.

tools.name: file_outline
tools.summary: Every indexed symbol in a file, in line order; takes a path glob.

tools.name: get_code
tools.summary: Read source for a symbol (id, name or wildcard), or a file/line range.

tools.name: find_usages
tools.summary: Who uses this symbol — inbound callers/importers, with call sites.

tools.name: traverse
tools.summary: N-hop walk from seed symbols, filtered by edge type and direction.

tools.name: shortest_path
tools.summary: Shortest directed edge path between two symbols.

tools.name: graph_schema
tools.summary: Node & edge types present in this graph, with counts.

tools.name: analyze
tools.summary: Whole-repo statistics, distributions and blast radius — a named preset or a raw GQL query over the indexed store.
tools.note: Store-backed: needs the indexed database (503 otherwise). The analyze preset catalog lives at GET /api/presets.

params: Canonical snake_case, same as the CLI flags and MCP tool params. Legacy camelCase spellings are accepted.
project: Optional `project` field targets another indexed project without changing the server's active one.

wildcards.syntax: * any run of chars, ? one char, [abc]/[a-z] a set or range, [!ab] negated, {a,b} alternatives, \* a literal star; patterns match the whole name, and in paths * stops at / while **/ crosses directories
wildcards.where: Anywhere a symbol or file is named: find_symbols.name / .node_types / .file_prefix, file_outline.file, and the node_id of get_code, find_usages, traverse and shortest_path — which also accept a plain symbol name instead of an id.
wildcards.expansion: In the id-taking tools a name or pattern expands to at most 25 symbols; hitting that cap is reported in the result, never silent.
